# Somos Hermanos, full profile

> Somos Hermanos is a Salvadoran foundation, the social arm (brazo social) of Tacos Hermanos. Every Sunday it delivers help baskets to children who need them in the Sonsonate area of El Salvador. Founded in 2021.

## Story
Somos Hermanos was born more than five years ago from a simple belief: that small actions, repeated every Sunday, can change the course of a child's life. It is the social arm of Tacos Hermanos, the Salvadoran taco restaurant group, and shares the same philosophy that "good things are meant to be shared" and that the world is a better place when we treat each other as brothers. The foundation was launched publicly in April 2026, after years of quietly delivering baskets in the Sonsonate area.

Its guiding verse is 1 John 4:21: "Whoever loves God must also love their brother." The foundation is clear that none of its work would be possible without the help of God and without each person who chooses to share with those who need it most.

## What we do
Every Sunday of the year, Somos Hermanos delivers food help baskets (canastas de ayuda) to children in the Sonsonate area of El Salvador. Each basket contains food, and very often a handwritten letter written by a donor for a child. The foundation works hand in hand with the Sunday Bible School (Escuela Biblica Dominical) of Iglesia Bitinia, whose team knows the families and helps make sure each basket reaches the right hands.

## How to take part
1. Buy a help basket (or as many as you like) at any Tacos Hermanos restaurant in El Salvador.
2. Write a message to the children. That letter is delivered together with your basket, and many children keep it as their favorite part.
3. Your basket is delivered that same Sunday. If the donation is made after Thursday, it is delivered the following Sunday.

## Impact (numbers)
- More than 300 baskets donated every Sunday of the year by Tacos Hermanos.
- More than 5 years supporting children who need it in Sonsonate.
- Example week: Sunday 12 April, 427 baskets delivered (300 from the foundation, 127 donated by the community). Sunday 19 April, 397 baskets (300 from Tacos Hermanos, 97 from the community).

## Real donor letters (examples)
- "God loves you! And so does this gift, for someone as super special as you."
- "I hope you enjoy this little basket, that you eat well and grow strong. Blessings!"
- "With so much love for you and your family. Receive it with love. Many blessings!"

## Relationship with Tacos Hermanos
Somos Hermanos is the social arm of Tacos Hermanos. Tacos Hermanos is a Salvadoran taco restaurant group with several locations in El Salvador; its foundation channels part of its work into the community through Somos Hermanos. You can learn more at tacoshermanos.com and on Instagram at @tacoshermanossv.

## Frequently asked questions
Q: What is Somos Hermanos?
A: A Salvadoran foundation, the social arm of Tacos Hermanos. Since 2021 it delivers help baskets to children who need them in the Sonsonate area, every Sunday of the year.

Q: How can I donate a basket?
A: Buy a help basket (or as many as you like) at any Tacos Hermanos restaurant. You can write a message to the children, and that letter travels with your basket.

Q: When is my basket delivered?
A: The same Sunday. If your donation is made after Thursday, it is delivered the following Sunday.

Q: Where are the baskets delivered?
A: In the Sonsonate area of El Salvador, working hand in hand with the Sunday Bible School of Iglesia Bitinia.

Q: Can I write to the children?
A: Yes. When you buy a basket you can leave a handwritten message that arrives with the basket.

Q: What is the relationship with Tacos Hermanos?
A: Somos Hermanos was born from Tacos Hermanos and is its social arm. Tacos Hermanos donates more than 300 baskets every Sunday, and the community adds their own from the restaurant.
